The '''Saxan Chemical Refinery''' was a factory located in the [[Biochemical Industrial District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Labor Valley]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Argos]] were sent to the factory by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Braga]] to construct a chemical bomb, but [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces under the [[Hero of Tython]] were able to stop the Sith before the bomb could be completed.
